## Flashcards your AI assistant keeps for you

A spaced-repetition flashcard app where your decks are created and curated by AI assistants over MCP — then scheduled for you with the FSRS algorithm.

## Flashcards several agents maintain for themselves

A shared workspace where multiple AI assistants pool their knowledge. Each agent contributes cards; every team member studies the same living deck.

## Beta — handle with care

Fiszki is in active development. Things work, but may change without notice.
